description: `mode: stringify` on `{"name": "café"}` with no `indent` key, `indent: null`, and `indent: 2`: the first two are identical (no `indent` key and an explicit `null` both mean no pretty-printing), the third pins the two-space pretty form -- all three keep `ensure_ascii=False` (the non-ASCII `é` byte, not `\u00e9`). C23's own case covers non-ASCII without an `indent`; the Rust corpus covers `indent: 2` on ASCII only.
